items.q: The ball is ___ the box. (inside it)
items.explain: Inside something means in.

items.q: The cat is ___ the table. (below it)
items.explain: Below something means under.

items.q: The book is ___ the desk. (on top of it)
items.explain: On top of something means on.

items.q: The boy is ___ the tree. (at its back)
items.explain: At the back of something means behind.

items.q: The bird is ___ the house. (higher than it)
items.explain: Higher than something means above.

items.q: The shop is ___ the school. (close to it)
items.explain: Close to something means near.

items.q: The dog is ___ the two chairs. (in the middle)
items.explain: In the middle of two things means between.

items.q: The car is ___ the garage. (inside it)
items.explain: Inside something means in.

items.q: The shoes is ___ the bed. (below it)
items.explain: Below something means under.

items.q: The cup is ___ the plate. (on top of it)
items.explain: On top of something means on.

items.q: The girl is ___ the door. (at its back)
items.explain: At the back of something means behind.

items.q: The moon is ___ the hills. (higher than them)
items.explain: Higher than something means above.

items.q: Riya is my friend. ___ lives near me.
items.explain: Riya is a girl, so we use she.

items.q: Arjun likes cricket. ___ plays every day.
items.explain: Arjun is a boy, so we use he.

items.q: The dog is hungry. ___ wants food.
items.explain: A dog is an animal, so we use it.

items.q: Meena and Ravi are here. ___ are my cousins.
items.explain: Two people means they.

items.q: My mother is a doctor. ___ works at a hospital.
items.explain: Mother is a woman, so we use she.

items.q: Grandpa tells stories. ___ is very funny.
items.explain: Grandpa is a man, so we use he.

items.q: The kite is in the sky. ___ is very high.
items.explain: A kite is a thing, so we use it.

items.q: Tom and I play chess. ___ play after school.
items.explain: Tom and I means we.

items.q: The birds sing at dawn. ___ wake me up.
items.explain: Many birds means they.

items.q: Aunt Lata makes ladoos. ___ makes them for Diwali.
items.explain: Aunt Lata is a woman, so we use she.

items.q: The bus is late. ___ will come soon.
items.explain: A bus is a thing, so we use it.

items.q: My brothers love football. ___ play every evening.
items.explain: Many brothers means they.
